rationale: Split: plain random 25% hold-out with the run seed, as specified (no stratification because the target is defined after the split). Target: paid_amount > 95th percentile computed on train_only and applied unchanged to test, so the test partition never informs its own threshold; threshold.json records the value and per-partition positive rates. Features: only submission-time fields; all amount columns (billed, allowed, paid, member_oop, cob) are excluded because the label is derived from paid_amount and the others are near-collinear with it, high_cost_flag is excluded as a pre-computed label, and claim_id/member_id are excluded as identifiers, so id_fields_present and target_derived_present should both be empty. drg_present is a null indicator on drg_code (populated for 1,931 of 12,845 rows, effectively inpatient status) and is submission-time information. Preprocessing: encoder and standard scaler fitted on train_only; scaling helps logistic regression and is harmless to the tree model. Models: logistic regression plus gradient boosting as the single tree-based model, giving PR-AUC, ROC-AUC and precision/recall in the top 5% of held-out claims by score. Report: denominators printed for every rate (~5% positive class is imbalanced), every results bullet cites its artifact, and caveats cover synthetic data, class imbalance, baseline-model limitations and no operational use.
